\[
\cos^2 (x + y) = \frac{1 + \cos 2(x + y)}{2}
\]

Substitute this identity into the expression:
\[

\]

\[

\]

\[
\frac{1 + \cos 2x}{2} + \frac{1 + \cos 2(x + y)}{2} - 2 \cos x \cos y \cos (x + y)
\]

\[
\frac{1 + \cos 2x + 1 + \cos 2(x + y)}{2} - 2 \cos x \cos y \cos (x + y)
\]

\[

We can split this into two parts:

\[

\[
